description.value: Buckhorn & Main Mountain Eatery is the full-service restaurant and lounge inside Trickle Creek Lodge, a ski-in/ski-out resort at Kimberley Alpine Resort. The menu spans burgers, seafood, steaks, salads, and desserts, with a kids' menu and a lounge offering cocktails and draft beer on tap. Its location at the base of the alpine resort and near the Peak to Plaza trail network makes it a natural refuelling stop for cyclists exploring the Kimberley area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Buckhorn & Main Mountain Eatery is an active, open restaurant within Trickle Creek Lodge at 500 Stemwinder Drive, Kimberley, explicitly offering both dine-in and take-out. No bike-specific amenities (racks, pump, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the only parking referenced is automotive (underground heated, over-height, bus). Wi-Fi is confirmed for hotel suites but is not explicitly extended to the restaurant dining space.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only.
OSM name uses '&' while the website alternates between '&' and 'and' — OSM form retained as primary.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant with confirmed dine-in and take-out service at a resort property in Kimberley.
